# Report - video23, L1 proxy, Three.js sampled-frame baseline (round 1)

Representation: L1 (proxy). Three.js sampled-frame baseline; not equivalent to Blender model rankings.

Observed (24 reference samples, 0-12.88 s): a single continuous third-person game shot in a sunlit market alley. The player (navy shirt, brown trousers) crouches behind a teal table at the alley mouth with red smoke drifting to his front-left, alternating between low cover framing and close over-the-right-shoulder aiming framing (aim at ~0.57-1.68 s, ~3.37-3.92 s, ~6.72-7.28 s; muzzle flashes visible at 0.57, 3.92, 6.72, 7.28 s). Three enemies (grey trousers, light shirts, dark vests, red caps) stand down the alley near an orange crate and a red shuttered kiosk; they are shot down one by one. At ~7.85 s the player leaves cover, dive-rolls (~8.4 s), sprints down the alley (8.97-10.1 s), crouches near the bodies and picks up a rifle (~11.2 s), turns left toward a body (~11.77 s) and runs to tiled steps leading to a plaza (12.3-12.9 s), with the camera following behind.

Geometry: boxes/cylinders/spheres for ground, cover table, left shelving stall, left corrugated kiosk with yellow slats, right bottle table/cabinet, green toy stall, rotated red kiosk with shutter panels, orange crate, three tiled steps, plaza pillar/counter/roof, background buildings; translucent spheres for red smoke (fades out ~7.4-8.3 s) and grey smoke near the plaza.

Articulation: generic humanoid proxy (pelvis, torso, head, 2-segment arms and legs). Poses: cover squat, aim (two-hand pistol), lunge, forward roll (body pitch), procedural run cycle, crouch-run, pick-up squat, standing with rifle. Enemies: aim stance, run cycle (first enemy), and fall-to-lying-on-back death animations at ~1.62 s, ~3.40 s and ~7.26 s. Muzzle flash spheres at inferred shot times. Pistol swaps to rifle at ~11.05 s.

Camera: single continuous shot, no cuts. Camera is a lagged follow of the player anchor with eased offset keyframes for cover, close-cover, aim (narrower FOV 42) and run framings.

Inference vs observation: exact shot/death times, enemy routes between samples, transition timings between cover and aim, and the roll/run path are inferred from the 0.55 s sampling. HUD, subtitles and button prompts are overlay elements and are intentionally not reproduced.

Feedback: none received yet (initial generation).
